name: Intimate Relations
source:
As soon as he was old enough to call himself a man, Andrew proposed to Jane, his high school sweetheart. Things seemed great, and with her support he manged to climb up the corporate ladder very quickly. A few years later, Jane became pregnant. And 9 months after, Kelly was born.

Now Kelly is attending an University in the same city they live. She never wanted to go too far away form her dad. Andrew got her a place closer to school, but she still spends half of her time at home.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/PTOLEMYGAMES]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
当安德鲁长大到可以称自己为男人时，他就向他高中时的恋人简求婚了。一切似乎都很棒，在她的支持下，他很快就在公司晋升了。几年后，简怀孕了。9个月后，凯利出生了。

现在凯利正在他们居住的同一城市的一所大学上学。她从来不想离开父亲太远。安德鲁给她安排了一个离学校较近的地方，但她仍然有一半的时间呆在家里。
